n: This short psalm repeats Psalm 40:13–17 almost word for word, as a stand-alone urgent prayer. The heading says it is “to bring to remembrance” — perhaps to remind God, or to accompany a memorial offering.

f.w: Make haste, O God, to deliver me

n: May those trying to take his life be frustrated, confused and driven back.
May the mockers who say “Aha, aha!” be turned back by their own shame.
In contrast, may all who seek God rejoice and keep saying, “God is great!”
He admits his need and asks God to hurry — don’t delay! The prayer ends without resolution, but with trust.
